text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high 429 spike observed in hosted-api (us-east-1). Alert group: rate-limiter-errors. Change detected from deploy dpl-20270315-14 (rate-config:v2). Root service: rl-service-prod. Please acknowledge.

sasha: acked. I'm on it, taking first response. what changed in v2? any canary anomalies?

deploy-bot: deploy dpl-20270315-14 started at 2027-03-15T14:05:23Z. rollout strategy: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. feature flags: rlv2-enforce=true, rlv2-exemptions=v2. config diff:
```
- token_accounting: legacy
+ token_accounting: grouped_bucket_v2
- exemptions: static-list
+ exemptions: dynamic-policy-v2
```

matt: saw canary graphs — 10% canary showed 3x 429, threshold wasn't set to abort on 3x for short window. looks like the canary check window config didn't pick up spike.

carol: if 10% already 3x, we should kill the rollout. Sasha, can you flip the flag while we pause? rlv2-enforce=false will force old behavior.

sasha: on it. running: `redwood-cli feature-flags set rlv2-enforce false --env=prod --reason="emergency rollback - overthrottle"`

deploy-bot: feature flag rlv2-enforce set to false (propagating). PID: ff-prop-983. Estimated propagation: 30s.

sasha: metrics: raw 429 rate dropping in the canary hosts. overall 429 rate for prod down from 12x -> 2.1x in 90s. still seeing customer-facing 429s for some routes.

ben: we should also start rollback of the rate-limiter deployment. initiating `kubectl -n rl rollout undo deployment/rl-service --to-revision=202` (orchestration will map to pre-v2).

deploy-bot: rollback job started: rollback-job-2076543254. targeting all pods in us-east-1 first.

matt: while the flag flip helped, we're seeing a subset of tokens being double-counted in grouped_bucket_v2. logs: 
```
ERROR rl-token: token_charge mismatch token_id=usr-7a3, expected=1, charged=2, reason=policy-mismatch
WARN rl-exempt: no exemption found for internal-service-account svc-internal-auth
```
These two together explain burst over-throttle: exemptions not applied + token accounting double charge.

support-bot: creating customer-impact tickets. initial list: ACME-1245 (acme-inc), STREAM-890 (streamly), EDUCO-77 (educo). marking as potential downtime / degraded. Notifying account teams.

carol: escalate to SRE & runtime. @matt please take lead on root cause after stabilization. Sasha continue to monitor and coordinate with support.

sasha: agreed. updating status page: "Degraded performance for some text-generation routes in us-east-1. Mitigation in progress."

oncall-next: i'm taking next shift in 25m. please handoff once things are stable.

matt: quick note on canary config bug: the canary abort rule uses `error_rate_increase > 5x over 5m` but our spike was a 12x for 90s then partially recovered -> no abort. we should tighten short-window abort rules. adding to postmortem checklist.

ben: rollback completed for us-east-1 at 2076543420. rollout undone to revision 202. health checks passing. CPU/mem stable. 429 rates approaching baseline.

sasha: confirmed: 429s for affected routes back to normal baseline. support-bot, please queue customers for outreach and offer incident summary.

support-bot: outreach queued. created follow-ups: ACME-1245 assigned to paula, STREAM-890 assigned to diego, EDUCO-77 assigned to lena. template note: apology + ETA for root-cause + mitigation steps taken.

emily: thanks all. can we get a short timeline for SOC/exec update? need 1-2 bullet summary.

sasha: timeline (short):
- 2076543210 incident page/alert triggered
- 2076543225 acknowledge by sasha
- 2076543230 flag flip rlv2-enforce=false triggered
- 2076543254 rollback job started
- 2076543420 rollback completed in us-east-1
- 2076543460 metrics recovered to baseline

emily: good. summary for execs: "A recent rate-limiter rollout (rate-config:v2) introduced a dynamic exemptions policy and new token accounting (grouped_bucket_v2). Canary checks missed a short 12x spike, causing the rollout to continue. Two issues combined: missing exemptions for internal service accounts and a token double-charge bug. Mitigation: emergency feature flag flip + rollback to previous release. Customer impact: transient 429s for a small fraction of hosted-api traffic; outreach in progress."

matt: also capturing action items: tighten canary abort window (1m short-window), add integration test for exemptions mapping, add unit test for grouped_bucket token charge behavior, and run a canary-sim traffic test next deploy.

carol: creating incident channel and postmortem doc now: #incidents-2076543210. tagging owners.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked mitigated at 2076543560. Severity: P2. Incident channel: #incidents-2076543210. Please populate the postmortem template within 72h.

oncall-next: taking handoff. sasha — anything I should watch before I log off?

sasha: watch for residual 429s on `/v1/generate` and any support tickets spiking for ACME or STREAM. otherwise should be stable. handing over logs + local dashboard link.

oncall-next: ack.

sasha: thanks team. moving to follow-up tasks.

support-bot: incident summary created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2076543210 (internal link).
